title: mentha arvensis var. canadensis
intro: Mentha arvensis var. canadensis, commonly known as Canadian Wild Mint or American Wild Mint, is a subspecies of the Mentha arvensis species, a perennial herb native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine to relieve digestive issues, such as nausea and indigestion, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving gut health. The therapeutic actions of Mentha arvensis var. canadensis include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory agent, which contributes to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and menthyl acetate, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in aromatherapy and herbal remedies.
